items.title: How an SSP runs an auction
steps: The page asks the SSP for an ad
The SSP sends a bid request to DSPs
The SSP applies the floor and picks the winner
The winning ad is returned to the page
items.why: The SSP collects bids, applies the floor, and returns the winner.

items.title: How a publisher sets up a PMP deal
steps: The publisher and buyer agree terms
The publisher creates a deal ID in the SSP
The buyer’s DSP receives the deal ID
The buyer bids on matching impressions
The SSP picks the highest bid above the deal floor
The ad serves and the deal is reported
items.why: The deal ID links both sides before any bid happens.
